attr.title: Airline Tycoon Deluxe
attr.desc: Build an airline empire from one rented plane. Hire crews, fight rival airlines for routes and sabotage them in the lobby. Runesoft's official Linux build runs through box86.
attr.inst: GOG: copy the Linux offline installer (gog_airline_tycoon_deluxe_*.sh) into ports/airlinetycoon/gamedata, it is unpacked on first launch. Steam: download depot 331922 of app 331920 for Linux and copy its contents into ports/airlinetycoon/gamedata.
attr.inst_md:
**GOG:** copy the Linux offline installer (`gog_airline_tycoon_deluxe_*.sh`) into `ports/airlinetycoon/gamedata`. It is unpacked on first launch, then deleted.

**Steam (app 331920):** download the Linux depot `331922` from the Steam console (`steam://open/console`):

```
download_depot 331920 331922
```

or with DepotDownloader: `DepotDownloader -app 331920 -depot 331922 -os linux -username <your Steam name>`.

Copy the contents of the depot into `ports/airlinetycoon/gamedata`, so that `ATDeluxe`, `lib32` and `room` sit directly in it.
